raw_segments.text: Gentlemen, he cried, I see that I am lost, but she! Tell me about her, I beseech you.
Surely she need not be ruined with me. She's innocent, you know, she was out of her mind
when she cried last night, it's all my fault. She's done nothing, nothing. I've been grieving
over her all night as I sat with you. Can't you, won't you tell me what you are going
